description: Defines the LayerLifecycleManager class responsible for managing RequestedLayerStates, their lifecycle, and state changes within the Android surfaceflinger frontend. Includes methods for adding layers, applying transactions, handling handle destruction, fixing hierarchy loops, and managing lifecycle listeners.

classes.name: LayerLifecycleManager
classes.description: Manages a collection of RequestedLayerStates, their lifecycle, and state changes, including adding layers, applying transactions, handling handle destruction, fixing hierarchy loops, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: LayerLifecycleManager::ILifecycleListener
classes.description: Interface for callbacks triggered on layer addition and destruction during lifecycle changes.

methods.name: addLayers
methods.description: Adds new RequestedLayerStates to the manager.

methods.name: applyTransactions
methods.description: Applies a set of TransactionStates to update layer states, with an option to ignore unknown layers.

methods.name: onHandlesDestroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of layer handles, with an option to ignore unknown handles.

methods.name: fixRelativeZLoop
methods.description: Detaches a layer from its parent to prevent hierarchy loops.

methods.name: commitChanges
methods.description: Destroys marked layers, invokes callbacks, and clears change flags.

methods.name: addLifecycleListener
methods.description: Registers a new lifecycle event listener.

methods.name: removeLifecycleListener
methods.description: Removes a registered lifecycle event listener.

methods.name: getGlobalChanges
methods.description: Returns the aggregate of changes since last commit.
